name: Ammunition (Firearms): Quickshot musket ball (5)
body:
Quickshot musket balls function like normal musket balls in all ways, except they have an alchemical coating that allows them to be fired without black powder. As such, they can be loaded into a pistol or musket as a free action,and the user can attack with a gun up to his full number of attacks.
